_comment: EmbeddingGemma 2 for the Neural Engine (owner 2026-10-09): the pinned files api/services/model_fetch.py downloads once into $CICADA_HOME/models/<dir_name>, each checked against its sha256 and size before anything is installed. `files` is the text encoder, fetched on the person's click (Settings, make embedding-model-gemma2). `vision_files` (2026-10-14, design taste) is the image encoder and its patch-position table, fetched only on a second click of its own (the Looks page, make embedding-model-vision) into the same folder beside the text encoder, which it needs: an image's tokens are embedded by the text model, so a screenshot lands in the text vectors' space. The audio encoder in the same repository is never fetched. Bump `revision` and every hash together, and give `dir_name` a new value with them: macOS caches the Neural Engine compile against the compiled model's path, so a new revision must never land at an old path.
